parole.significato: madder (Rubia tinctorum) and the pigment from it
parole.testo: Borrowed from German Krapp, itself from Middle Dutch crappe, from Proto-Germanic *krappô (“hook”), a reference to the plant’s hook-shaped thorns.

parole.significato: a haggler, one who procures small sales
parole.testo: Borrowed from German Makler or Middle Dutch makelare, substituting its ending with -а́к (-ák).
